correctness.rationale: Exact shifted Legendre recurrence and telescoping rational trace prove the first formula. Uniform finite-window closed-walk moment convergence, polynomial functional calculus, and weighted-shift Schatten-tail estimates prove the global p>1 constant. A separate norm bound and minmax lower bound from positive spectral density establish every fixed-index edge; finite-rank perturbation of the known Volterra spectrum gives the exact p>1 threshold. The included checker passed 3,054 independently recomputed finite identities and witness comparisons. The proof uses no finite enumeration to establish its universal statements.

value.rationale: Removing orthogonal polynomial moments is a canonical spectral-filtering procedure. The exact full residual Hilbert-Schmidt energy, sharp operator norm and fixed-index singular edge, and gamma-exact all-real-p Schatten-mass profile quantify different aspects of the surviving integration error. These are nontrivial infinite-dimensional statistics with explicit natural dependence on the number of moments, useful for numerical residual control and approximation-number estimates; no downstream theorem or speedup is asserted.
